## Clever Devices - Senior Full Stack Software Engineer – React Native

🔗 [Apply](https://apply.workable.com/clever-benefits/j/A98E9DC3FC)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior React Native Engineer scaling custom-branded telemedicine apps for Clever Benefits. Owning releases, shared architecture, and production mobile experiences across healthcare client portfolios.
Senior React Native Engineer scaling custom-branded telemedicine apps and healthcare CRMs at Clever Benefits
- Tech stack: Android, AWS, iOS, JavaScript, MongoDB, Node.js, Postgres, React, React Native, TypeScript
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Own mobile features end-to-end, from scoping and stakeholder identification through delivery
- Own the full release cycle, including versioning, build pipelines, App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and rollbacks
- Build and maintain shared mobile architecture for multiple custom-branded client apps
- Debug across the React Native and native boundary
- Keep apps ahead of iOS and Android platform requirements
- Contribute to system design and uphold standards for code quality, testing, and reliability
- Participate in code reviews and collaborate with teammates on technical challenges
- Communicate with team members, leadership, and clients to deliver business outcomes
- 4+ years building and shipping production mobile applications, with significant depth in React Native and TypeScript
- Personally shipped apps to both the App Store and Google Play and owned the release and review process
- Comfortable working in native code, including Xcode and Android Studio output, native dependency and SDK issues, and platform-specific bugs
- Experience with offline behavior, deep linking, push notifications, secure local storage, and performance profiling
- Solid foundation in Node.js, tRPC, MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL, and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CDK)
- Comfortable scoping work, identifying edge cases, and challenging requirements without heavy product management support
- Passionate about system design, code quality, type-safety, and long-term maintainability
- Clear communicator who values collaboration and contributes to a positive, inclusive team culture

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior React Native Engineer scaling custom-branded telemedicine apps for Clever Benefits. Owning releases, shared architecture, and production mobile experiences across healthcare client portfolios.
Senior React Native Engineer scaling custom-branded telemedicine apps and healthcare CRMs at Clever Benefits
Role description:
• Own mobile features end-to-end, from scoping and stakeholder identification through delivery
• Own the full release cycle, including versioning, build pipelines, App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and rollbacks
• Build and maintain shared mobile architecture for multiple custom-branded client apps
• Debug across the React Native and native boundary
• Keep apps ahead of iOS and Android platform requirements
• Contribute to system design and uphold standards for code quality, testing, and reliability
• Participate in code reviews and collaborate with teammates on technical challenges
• Communicate with team members, leadership, and clients to deliver business outcomes
Role requirements:
• 4+ years building and shipping production mobile applications, with significant depth in React Native and TypeScript
• Personally shipped apps to both the App Store and Google Play and owned the release and review process
• Comfortable working in native code, including Xcode and Android Studio output, native dependency and SDK issues, and platform-specific bugs
• Experience with offline behavior, deep linking, push notifications, secure local storage, and performance profiling
• Solid foundation in Node.js, tRPC, MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL, and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CDK)
• Comfortable scoping work, identifying edge cases, and challenging requirements without heavy product management support
• Passionate about system design, code quality, type-safety, and long-term maintainability
• Clear communicator who values collaboration and contributes to a positive, inclusive team culture
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to balance speed with quality
• Strong web-based React front-end skills (bonus)
• Experience with white-label or multi-tenant mobile apps (bonus)
• Experience in regulated domains such as healthcare (bonus)
• Based in or open to relocating to the Phoenix area (bonus)
Benefits:
• Health insurance through Redirect Health 100% Employer-sponsored
• New Apple laptop provided
• 3 weeks PTO plus 9 Federal holidays
Tech stack:
Android, AWS, iOS, JavaScript, MongoDB, Node.js, Postgres, React, React Native, TypeScript
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
